author: Lottoungen
body:
Okay, firstly I'm not sure if i posted this in right place, so feel free to move/tell me where it should be posted if this isn't correct.

My minecraft name is Lottoungen.
I've been playing on AV alot. However, my account was hijacked during the winter, I now got my account back but I noticed that I've been banned from several of my favorite servers. When I try to connect it says that I was banned of Forcefield and AntiKnockback, however as of my account was hacked at 28th December 2014 when this happend, I'm thinking that the hacker who hijacked my account used it for cheating on different servers. I've been playing alot on this server and its by far my favorite server to visit when i play Minecraft now and then. However I do not really have any proof that my account was hijacked. I'm still hoping you'd be able to unban me. I mean I wouldn't even hack from the first place and if I did I'd not create an account and make this forum post to get appealed. I was actually even considering making a staff application, but when my account got hijacked I started playing other games until recently when I found out I got my account back.

So I've got a questions, will I be able to apply for staff even though my account has been punished as a hacker?

I've not asked for a ban appeal before and I'm guessing a few months is enough to get appealed.

Sincerly,
your Lottoungen

Your minecraft Username: Lottoungen

Timezone: CEST / GMT+2

Experience: That list would be huuugee, but I can tell you a few, I've been staff on Minecraft alot, everything from small servers to large servers, moderator to co-owner. But also in other games like Rust, TF2 Counter-Strike series, Battlefield and so on. 

Have you ever been banned? If so explain?: You can read all about it here: https://avicus.net/forums/5783280b0 . 

Why do you believe you should be a moderator for Avicus?: I have been playing minecraft and AV alot, I must have atleast 2000 hours of minecraft and atleast a couple hundred on the AV server. I also have alot of experience of being staff in several diffrent kinds of servers and even other games. I feel like there's always a hacker or somebody swearing, greifing while mods are either offline or busy doing everything.

How would you benefit the Avicus staff team?: As of I live in a diffrent timezone then most other people I'll be online when there's not alot of other staff online. Two of my friends if former hackers/greifers and they've told me alot of the tricks that these kind of people do. It has helped me alot because I'll often be one step ahead of the hackers/greifers. I'd also make sure to punish those who greif, I've seen alot of moderators miss this. I have reported players that are breaking crates or greifing in other ways but rarely a mod would do something about it because there are hackers on the server.

If a player is using a hacked client on the server what in your opinion would be the most appropriate punishment?: In most cases, a permanent ban however if the player is only using for ex, anti-knockback I'd give them a temporary ban. 

If a player is swearing and being abusive on the server what in your opinion would be the most appropriate punishment?: Depending on how severe it is but generally I always tend to warn and then mute. 

If a player is team griefing or team spleefing on the server what in your opinion would be the most appropriate punishment?: If it happends once, warning and/or kick and more times I'd give a temporary ban for example 3 days.

Do you have the ability to record video?: Yes, I even have Shadowplay so I can save the last minutes of my gameplay so even if I do not have  time to start record I can still be able to get proof.

Do you own a microphone and have access to TeamSpeak 3 and Skype?: Yes, all three.

Sincerly, 

you Lottoungen

"Don't fear, Lotto is here"

Edit 1: Once looking through my infractions register I found temp ban which I have no idea about except that I remeber giving my friend my account for a weekend, but I have no memory of the ban itself. Possible it was he? But did I  get the ban afterwards? I remeber playing the same very weekend. Also, would this affect my ability to make a staff application? I already made one incase because there's not alot of days left.

p.s: Sorry for my bad English, it's not my first language.

title: Lottoungen - Ban Appeal

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello,

Looking at your ip i can see that you have recently logged in as Lars_olaf.

This on it's own is ban evading and therefore a instant deny on your appeal.

But i can see that Lars_olaf was also hacking. Which makes it even worse.

Both accounts will stay banned. And for your staff app for obvious reasons that is denied as-well.

Regards,
LegendaryEngram, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
